name: Agastyeshwara Sivalayam

location.address: Old city of Guntur, Andhra Pradesh

history.summary: Agastyeshwara Sivalayam is described by heritage-oriented sources as an ancient Shiva temple in Guntur city.

name_origin.summary: A local tradition associates the temple with Sage Agastya and a swayambhu linga.

sources.title: Places to visit in Guntur India
sources.supports: Identifies Agastyeshwara temple as an ancient temple in Guntur and describes its traditional historical context.

verification_notes: Traditional dates and legends are not treated as established historical facts. Coordinates, current management, inscriptions, architecture and additional primary sources still require verification.
